scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm just checking on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The loan type is a conventional first lien loan.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for letting me know! What is the interest rate on my loan, and are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on your loan is 8.000%. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me the total costs of this loan and whether it has been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The total costs of the loan are not present in the record. The loan was sold to another type of purchaser.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you explain what it means that my loan was sold to another type of purchaser? Also, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to a purchaser that is not a government-sponsored enterprise, a private-sector investor, or a mortgage insurer. The debt-to-income ratio for your loan is 49%. This ratio compares your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. It is used to assess your ability to repay the loan.
